title: Cookie banner setting cookies to the wrong place
body:
**Describe the bug**
The simorgh consent banner sets cookies to `www.bbc.com` whereas the pal sets them to `.bbc.com`. This causes weird behaviour where we read from 1 domain, but write to another. This means the cookie banner cant be dismissed in some cases

**Unconfirmed:**
It appears that our cookie banner will read cookies set on `.bbc.com` and set cookies on `www.bbc.com`, which means you cant correct the values, and it will show the banners on every refresh

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

On Chrome and Firefox 
1. Go to bbc.com/pidgin
2. Click on "Yes I agree" to the cookie settings
3. Refresh the page
4. See the cookie banner is displayed again 

**Expected behavior**
When you "Yes click I agree" then you don't see the cookie banner again when the page is refreshed

Simorgh sets cookies the same place that the pal does

comments.body:
Hey to reproduce you need to cross-pollenate your cookies a bit.

1. Clear your cookies
2. Visit https://www.bbc.com/pidgin
3. Visit a PAL page without accepting the cookies policy (i.e. https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/tori-51194083).
4. Still don't accept the cookies policy. Visit https://www.bbc.com/pidgin again.
5. You will now see the cookies banner repeatedly, even after accepting, while navigating through Simorgh pages.
6. If interested, you will now see the duplication of the cookies with different domains within your dev tools. One accepted, and one not.
![duplicate cookies](https://i.imgur.com/L8gvLrI.png)

Looks good to me too. Cookie banner does not appear again on Simorgh or PAL once it has been accepted. If the cookies are not accepted, the banner continues to show.

The cookie banner does appear again if you have accepted it on bbc.com, but then go to bbc.co.uk.

Accepting cookie banner on .co.uk stops it showing on .com.
